aesthetic: Rasterbruch — Swiss institutional precision fractured by New Wave disruption; a modular grid system that visibly destabilizes as provocative AI questions strain against rational structure
chromaticArc: Opens in near-black monotone with sharp red punctuation, bleeds through electric cobalt and alarm gold in the turbulent middle sections, then resolves into cleaner bone-white-on-black compositions with spectral violet and synthetic green as quiet final accents — mirroring the arc from disorientation to structured curiosity.
gridStrategy: Early slides use fragmented, overlapping zones with extreme asymmetry and competing type scales to create density; middle slides deploy aggressive split compositions and diagonal visual weight; final third progressively resolves into breathable, centred or single-anchor layouts — the grid literally calms as the course framework crystallises.

fontStrategy.secondarySlides: Georgia appears on reflective or philosophical slides — questions about AI's nature, the singularity, human displacement — where italic serif humanises the provocation against Futura's institutional clarity. Courier New surfaces on data-driven or technical-framework slides to signal systematic classification.

accentStrategy: Dot accents (span 2 circles) form a constellation motif across the deck, appearing at shifting grid coordinates to create a connect-the-dots subliminal pattern; thick bars (span 4–8) bisect compositions on 50%+ of slides as visual caesuras; colour blocks anchor corners or bleed off-grid on signal slides to rupture the Swiss scaffold.
